checks.requirement: Wait for document.fonts.ready and verify expected faces; export must not silently use fallback fonts.
Inspect PDF font inventory; ensure required fonts are embedded/subsetted as supported by the export path.
Hindi text must remain searchable/selectable in exported PDF; page must not be rasterized as a single image.
Visual inspect all proof strings; no broken matras, conjuncts, nukta marks or detached half forms.
Danda/double danda never sit alone at the beginning of a line.
Long headlines/body copy trigger a specific overflow warning and recovery suggestion.
Switching templates preserves stories, images, captions, credits and publication metadata.
Images load, use intended crop, preserve aspect ratio and include captions/credit where entered.
PDF media/trim dimensions match the selected format and orientation.
Story continuation and folios reference real page numbers; no empty trailing page.
Test export after fonts/assets are locally available and without a warm remote cache.
No horizontal page-level overflow; controls remain usable on all listed viewports.
Primary mobile touch targets aim for 44-48 CSS px/dp where practical; keyboard focus also visible.
Render every exported page to PNG and visually inspect at fit-page and 100% size.

requiredTestArtifacts: PDF output for every paper format
PNG rendering of every PDF page
test report including failures and skipped checks
